variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single new game UI icon or map marker for the original top-down pixel-art game Borrowed Light. Use a restrained, weathered mechanical visual language: a dark graphite outline, warm oxidized brass, and a small pale jade status light. Chunky, hard stepped pixel clusters on an intentional roughly 32 by 32 logical pixel grid, crisp nearest-neighbor enlargement, 5 to 8 colors, a high-contrast silhouette legible at 32 screen pixels. Center one compact icon on a square genuinely transparent canvas, framed with about 15% clear margin on each side. Transparent all around the silhouette. No scene, no solid tile or square backing, no grid, no typography, no letters, no numbers, no drop shadow, no blur, no bloom, no gradients, no antialias look. It is a symbol for a save checkpoint, not an inventory illustration. Subject: a squat chunky memory cartridge with two large bottom contacts, a bevelled upper corner, and one large simple jade confirmation check inset in the face. Favor a rectangular asymmetric silhouette. Front-facing orthographic read with just one pixel of edge depth.
